task_title: CLI startup: precompile dist path + lazy-load S3 subtree
task_criteria: bin/duckbrain.js no longer pays tsx on-the-fly compile on the hot path (uses precompiled dist/ or lazy tsx fallback) and read-only recall no longer transitively loads @aws-sdk/client-s3 (lazy require in git/autocommit). pnpm build + tsc --noEmit green, full vitest suite green, and a timing probe shows the CLI boot path loads no aws-sdk module.
